metadata.title: Punbahan Chakhwi: MUTTON DISH OF INDIGENOUS PEPOLE | कलोई जनजाति की ख़ास मटन रेसिपी
metadata.description:
In a special episode of The Tribal Kitchen, Main Bhi Bharat editor Chitrita Sanyal takes viewers on a delightful culinary journey into the heart of the Kalai tribe’s traditions. Shot in a picturesque tribal village nestled in the serene Jampui Hills of Tripura, this episode shines a spotlight on Punbahan Chakhwi, a cherished dish prepared by the Kalai tribe during special occasions and celebrations. Known for its rich, earthy flavors and cultural significance, Punbahan Chakhwi is made with locally sourced ingredients, including garlic, turmeric, ginger and mutton, reflecting the tribe’s deep connection with nature and sustainable food practices.
Chitrita Sanyal explores the recipe and the vibrant stories behind it, immersing viewers in the Kalai tribe's customs and rituals. The episode celebrates the resilience and creativity of tribal communities, showcasing their culinary heritage while highlighting the importance of preserving such traditions. This must-watch episode beautifully combines storytelling, culture, and cuisine.
